title: Pesto Pasta with Ricotta and Almonds
subtitle: with fresh basil pesto
description: Short pasta tossed in a homemade basil, lemon and parmesan pesto, topped with fresh ricotta and sliced almonds.

steps.text: Blend the garlic, basil and lemon juice in a food processor. Add a handful of walnuts (or almonds) and the parmesan and keep blending. Gradually add the olive oil and blend to a smooth paste.
Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.
Fill a frying pan halfway with water and bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce the heat, add the pesto and stir until smooth.
Add the pasta to the pan and toss until the sauce reduces and coats the pasta.
Serve on plates, topping each portion with a spoonful of fresh ricotta and a few almonds.
